notes.title: Patch 1.3 | Updating Traditional Chinese and Korean Grammatical Issues
notes.content:
Hey Cultists,

We have just released a small patch note which fixes some minor graphic details, updated traditional Chinese and Korean texts, and more.

Full Patch Notes

 Solved a bug in the market that softlock the master in an animation when entering in a market (robot) if pressed on the Robot seller when the master is walking inside.
 Fixed some minor graphic details.
 Updated credits welcoming traditional Chinese and Korean translators.
 Updated traditional Chinese and Korean texts correcting many grammatical issues.
 Fixed a bug (but no locker one) in the cult chapter where a contextual balloon could be opened within a dialogue between characters.

- Riv Otter

notes.title: Universe for Sale - save system change patch
notes.content:
Hey cultists,

We have just released a patch which changes the save system in Universe for Sale which makes them more stable.

Unfortunately, saves from before this patch can’t be carried over to this new save system. We have opened a beta branch which will allow players to continue saves from before this patch.

To join the beta branch follow these steps.
[olist]
 Right click Universe for Sale on the side bar and click properties
 Click the Beta tab in the Steam window that opens up
 In the drop down menu in Beta Participation, select "old-savegame"
 Steam should start downloading the branch automatically and you’ll be on the old save system again!
[/olist]
Thank you all for working with us.

- Riv Otter

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.5 - Fixing various softlocks
notes.content:
Hey cultists,

We have released a patch to fix some of the various softlocks that have been reported plus fixing the steam overlay appearing upside down.

Bug Fixes

 War Chapter: players should now be able to progress past shooting the first set of robots.
 Game shouldn't softlock when clicking haphazardly when entering rooms.
 Lila’s Market: softlocks in various places of this chapter should be resolved.
 Teahouse: players should no longer softlock during the first universe making scene.
 Fixed small graphical bugs and typos
 Steam overlay no longer appears upside down when notifications pop up.

- Riv otter

notes.title: Universe for Sale coming out on November 16th
notes.content:
Hey cultist,

Universe for Sale now has a release date! On November 16th we will be able to create universes and sell them on the market on Jupiter!

https://youtu.be/hfQoVg3ADT4

Visiting Jupiter in a space station nestled in the clouds, you’ll learn the mysteries of the colony and the people that live under the failing shield protecting the colony from acid rain. A cultist meets a young woman with the ability to craft universes from liquids and depending on what is in that liquid changes the contents of the universe.

Universe for Sale won Best Art at BIG 2023 + Best Narrative at Overcome Film Game Awards! 

It’s time to plan what type of universes you will design.

- Riv Otter
